items.title: Ed Polcer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: I have a very interesting concert on January 1st at the Museum of Modern Art in New York in connection with the Jackson Pollock art exhibit... Jackson Pollock was a jazz fan

ctx.x: It pushed them towards rock almost.

Yeah. I can’t fault it because in art, I mean art takes different patterns. I mean when you compare a realist painting with a Jackson Pollock for instance, you don’t even know, you’re not even using the same guides. It’s a different ball game.
It’s interesting when you listen to the early rock, that as you said before, “Rock Around the Clock” is a swing-blues, right?
